reviews.title: Inaccurate and Incomplete
reviews.text:
Really disappointing calorie counter and similarly disappointing nutritional information.
Food database is very limited. Measuring system is restricted.
AI scan feature is guesstimate at best and often wide of the mark.
Nowhere near as comprehensive as other available apps. Had NutraCheck before and will return once this subscription is done.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work well
reviews.text:
So far everything I’ve taken a picture of has been wrong from ingredients to calories. The app told me a St Germain Spritzer was almost 500 calories. (It’s 115). It also couldn’t tell shrimp from chicken. It doesn’t work well at restaurants so you’re still stuck guessing the calories and nutrition facts. 

Update: It’s been over a month and it’s about as much work trying to get the scans to be correct vs just adding it yourself. Still not very impressed. 

60 day update: don’t pay for this app. I took 3 separate pictures of the same cookie and got 3 different calorie counts. SMH

Update 255 days in. Still works poorly. It doesn’t learn from previous entries. Terrible app.

Update 331 days in. Still don’t like the app, still doesn’t give accurate info, is glitchy with its daily tracking so the app definitely has bugs to work out. 34 more days and I’ll be rid of the subscription.

Update: after almost a year, you’d think there would be some updates and improvements, but there have been none.

Update: 370 days. Meh

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: I find that this app is good for certain things to scan but obviously is not able to judge thickness of bread etc so gives a calorie count for a sliced piece of bread , obv not able to tell if whole milk on cereal etc so gives calorie count for semi skimmed , it has given me an accurate calorie count for my sachet coffee which is 60 cals only to give me a calorie count of 2 cals the following day . We had a roast dinner , my husband had a bigger portion yet his calorie count was lower than mine , on the whole I don’t think this app is particularly accurate.

reviews.title: Barely works
reviews.text: This app only works about half of the time. Some days it won’t scan barcodes at all, some days it will scan them but doesn’t add the correct info so I have to manually enter it, and lately the app won’t even open so I’m back to keeping track of my food on a sheet of paper. I wish I had not spent my money on this app and had gotten MyFitnessPal instead. I want my money back since this app doesnt ever work properly. Don’t waste your time or money on this one.

reviews.title: Slow
reviews.text: This is the third time I have had to delete and re install the app. When it works it’s great! Everything you need but it doesn’t last long after downloading before it slows down. It doesn’t load properly, each page takes ages to load, it crashes regularly. I have an iPhone so maybe it’s just not compatible? It’s a shame as like I say when it works it has everything you need to track and lose weight

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I purchased this app with the expectation that using the photo feature it would be accurate or close to accurate so far. I’ve had the app for two days. I’ve used it 14 times and it’s only been accurate twice.
I asked Apple twice if I could be refunded since the app did not meet my expectations and they refused saying that reason for refund was not valid. I have never left a bad review for anything. I would’ve been happy to get my $19 + refunded But since that didn’t happen, I figure I’m obligated to inform other purchasers to be advised it may not work the way they want.

So the Developer responded to my review saying in essence they understood my frustration and they are updating the app. Look I asked for a refund of the $20 as the app for me is useless and a total waste of money.  It’s the first time I asked Apple for a refund since 2017 and they refused. I’m glad they are working on it but I spent my money … which will not be refunded for an app that does not work. Had they refunded me I would have written this off as a bad choice but now I stuck with an app that I paid for and does not do the job. I did cancel to make certain it does not auto renew next year. It stinks that I paid for this “work in progress “ All I wanted after the first day of using it was my money back. Don’t get stuck like I did.  Buy another app!
